name: aieditor
description: AI-ассистент для монтажа эдитов под музыку

scripts.dev:api: uv --directory backend run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765 --reload --reload-dir app
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && uv --directory backend sync && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/fetch_binaries.ps1
scripts.gen: uv --directory backend run gen-models && npm --prefix frontend run gen:types
scripts.gen:fixtures: uv --directory backend run python ../tools/gen_fixtures.py && uv --directory backend run gen-ramp-vectors
scripts.test: uv --directory backend run pytest -q && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.check: uv --directory backend run ruff check && uv --directory backend run pyright && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run lint
